hooks.command: s=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); echo "$s" | grep -qE '(index\.html|styles\.css|app\.js)$' && ! echo "$s" | grep -qE '(PROJECT_MEMORY\.md|NOTES\.md)$' && printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"Reminder: source files (index.html/styles.css/app.js) changed but PROJECT_MEMORY.md / NOTES.md were not updated - refresh the handoff docs (status + any new gotcha) before wrapping up."}' || true

f=$(node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{try{const p=require('path'),f=JSON.parse(s).tool_input.file_path||'',r=p.relative(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR||process.cwd(),f);if(f&&r&&!r.startsWith('..')&&!p.isAbsolute(r))process.stdout.write(f)}catch{}})"); case "$f" in *worker-briefs*|*.claude*|*node_modules*|*test-results*|*archive*) ;; *.js|*.mjs|*.css|*.html|*.md) node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs" --write --log-level warn "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; true
